name: open-code-review
description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: An automatic code reviewer that leaves precise, line-by-line comments on pull requests, catching bugs like crashes, security holes, and threading mistakes before a human even looks.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size company who wants fewer bugs reaching production without slowing down the team with mandatory long review cycles.
business_use_cases: A dev shop offers 'automated PR gatekeeping' as a service, plugging it into a client's GitHub org so every pull request gets reviewed before a human sees it.
A fintech or healthtech startup uses its built-in security ruleset (SQL injection, XSS) as a cheap first line of defense to satisfy compliance checklists.
An outsourced dev team uses it to hold contractors to a consistent quality bar without a senior engineer reviewing every line.

money_ideas.idea: Host it as a managed CI bot and charge per repository or per seat
Sell custom rule-set configuration for a company's specific stack and compliance needs

steal_this: This weekend, host it for a niche language community (e.g. Go microservices shops) as a free-tier GitHub App with a paid tier for private repos.
